WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?',\n  );\n  stmt.run(hp_current, status, successes, failures, campaignId, username);\n}\n\nexport function updatePlayMembershipDeathSaves(\n  campaignId: string,\n  username: string,\n  status: PlayMembershipStatus,\n  successes: number,\n  failures: number,\n): void {\n  const db = getDb();\n  const stmt = db.prepare(\n    'UPDATE play_members SET status = ?, death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = ? The server listens on `127.0.0.1`\nusing the port from the `PORT` environment variable (default `3000`).\n\nQuick health check:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:3000/health\n```\n\nExpected response:\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": true }\n```\n\nReset the SQLite database during testing:\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/v1/storage/reset\n```\n\n## Entry point and major modules\n\n| File / directory | Responsibility |\n| --- | --- |\n| `run.sh` | Compiles and starts the server in the foreground. |\n| `src/server.ts` | Entry point.
